task.title: Build the entry flow: username, league, team, progress
task.description:
## Why
This is the path every visitor takes to get a report.

## Steps
1. Build a landing page with a Sleeper username field and a link for entering a league id directly.
   Start loading the engine as soon as this page opens, so it is ready by the time the visitor has picked a league.
2. Show the user's leagues and let them pick one. Preselect their own team and allow choosing another team in the league.
3. On submit, run the report and show the progress messages until it finishes.
4. Put the league and team in the page address, so a bookmark or shared link rebuilds the same report in any browser.
5. Cover the error cases: unknown username, no leagues, league not found and Sleeper unavailable.

## Done when
- A visitor can go from a username to a finished report without leaving the site.
- Opening a report's address in another browser rebuilds it.
- Each error case shows a clear message and a way to try again.
